headline: Mexican stock market rises after two sessions of losses; Volaris leads gains
summary: Mexico's local stock indexes rose after returning from a long weekend and following two consecutive sessions of declines, with Volaris leading the advance.
why: The IPC is Mexico's benchmark equity index, tracking the country's largest listed companies and reflecting domestic investor sentiment.
original_headline: Bolsa mexicana avanza tras dos sesiones con caídas; Volaris lidera las ganancias
